name: znetwork_dplay_create_interface_and_coinitialize
description: zNetwork_DPlay::CreateInterfaceAndCoInitialize initializes COM, creates the DirectPlay4A COM object, stores the out pointer, reports selected COM creation failures, and returns the HRESULT.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The smoke patches ole32 CoInitialize/CoCreateInstance plus zNetwork_DPlay_ReportError and zError::ReportOld so COM and reporting branches are isolated.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48b730 validates the fastcall out-pointer ABI, CoInitialize(0), CoCreateInstance(CLSID_DirectPlay, 0, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_IDirectPlay4A, &localDirectPlay), store-through of the produced pointer, specific zError::ReportOld messages for 0x80040154, 0x80040110, and 0x800401f0, the no-generic-report return for 0x800401f0, the generic zNetwork_DPlay_ReportError line 0x39a for all other HRESULTs, and returning the original HRESULT.

The native smoke verifies successful creation, class-not-registered, class-cannot-be-created, not-initialized, and generic failure paths, including COM arguments, out-pointer storage, line numbers, and report fallthrough behavior.
